thread:
nina: FYI hit a bad onboarding footgun: our sample app docs tell users to set REDWOOD_API_KEY in .env, but our SDK prefers REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY when present. result: CI uses org key and fails auth for project-scoped resources.

omar: ouch. is this because we keep historical REDWOOD_API_KEY as the canonical name?

nina: yes. lots of infra and GH Actions secrets use that name so people copy-paste. when they add a project key, it silently loses precedence.

claire: proposal: unify names and introduce a compatibility shim. i.e. SDK reads in order: REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY, REDWOOD_API_KEY (legacy), and emit a single startup WARNING when both exist. docs updated to show `REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY` for sample apps.

omar: also add `rw whoami --show-scope` in CLI so devs can confirm which key is active. small UX win.

nina: +1. we should also add a short section in sample apps: "How to rotate keys without downtime" showing k8s secret update + `kubectl rollout restart` and GH Actions pattern with per-run ephemeral tokens.

claire: + tests across SDKs. add unit tests that mock envs and assert precedence. add an e2e using docker-compose overriding envs to catch regressions.

tooling-bot: Reminder: open RFC "env var canonicalization & precedence" and file bug repro.

nina: filed DEVX-8450 with docker-compose and GH Actions reproductions. i'll update sample app README and add a tiny migrator script that maps `REDWOOD_API_KEY` -> `REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY` when safe.

k8s-team: noted. we'll standardize secret keys to `redwood.project_key` in our charts and add compatibility mapping for existing clusters.

omar: can SDK also surface TTL metadata when token is short (<5m) so CI can fail early?

claire: yes, we'll add optional `token_ttl_warning` telemetry and a helper `redwood.auth.needsRefresh()` in node/python.

nina: thanks all. aim to merge docs + SDK change this week and post RFC link here. :shipit:
